findings.summary: All authoritative live surfaces resolve to Chloez Cafe at 5622 Ox Road Unit F, Fairfax Station, VA 22039.
The current boundary is 215 unique food and nonalcoholic products across the Owner-hosted and linked Toast live menus; alcohol-only categories and the non-food book row are excluded.
No current restaurant-issued catering menu was found on the official site, its document results, or linked Toast surface.
No official matrix was found after all four searches. No item-level cross-contact claims or unsupported absence claims are asserted.

The frozen Bacon & Broccoli Egg Burrito Low-Carb record contains wheat and gluten, while the current restaurant-issued description says its tortilla is made from eggs and labels it gluten free. The proposed current direct positive retains egg only; this narrow conflict requires Sol review.

proposedChanges: Replace the 115-row under-extracted projection with the 215-product union of the current Owner-hosted and linked Toast food/nonalcoholic menus.
Remove seven stale frozen products and two category-header artifacts; add current menu products and normalize categories.
Preserve direct positives with restaurant-issued or linked-vendor authority; mark all other products unavailable because no matrix exists.
Resolve the Low-Carb Bacon & Broccoli Egg Burrito wheat/gluten conflict narrowly before canonical apply.
